evidence.detail: Exact v308 extends the equipment root at interface 1644 and adds equipment/BOX controls labelled Show Equipment Stats and Show Items Kept on Death.
The class installs equipment slot background/outline sprites and a Remove action on the added equipment widget.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 builds the skills/SKILL interface surface with Total Level: 0 and a 24-skill grid.
The class embeds the full skill labels including Attack, Strength, Hitpoints, Mining, Agility, Smithing, Herblore, Fishing, Prayer, Magic, Construction, Hunter and Summoning.
